facts.fact: Kenyans.co.ke reports from Digital Health Agency tender documents that the DHA floated tenders for an AI-driven digital health platform for reproductive, maternal, newborn, child and adolescent health and an AI-managed national blood bank management system, within the Taifa Care platform.

KEN.note: The notification registry links disease surveillance to civil registration, not the civil register to the national ID system; tender stage only.
Only a tendered birth-and-death notification registry is named; no digital civil register is stated.
FHIR guide support for Taifa Care and the Health Information Exchange is mandated for consultants; no exchange between systems is stated as built or in service.
Taifa Care is named only as the platform being overhauled; the document does not state a national routine reporting system in service.
No ID number at birth is mentioned.
The tendered birth-and-death notification registry is a notification, not office registration; no office entry stated.
